column1: # EXP-R2-224 first-round stage-01 Swiss-Prot context-information qualification,
# progen2-large and progen2-xlarge on the eight frozen EXP-R2-216 blocks.
# The eight blocks reproduce ProGen2-medium's frozen `swissprot_progen2_medium_f32`
# draw exactly: seeded permutation of the whole corpus at --cohort-draw-seed 20260728,
# pool 1000, --cohort-skip 7000k for k = 0..7, band 64-246, n 200, held-out unigram
# reference 4000, --seed 20260727. Cohort.digest hashes records only, so each cell's
# expect basename carries that block's medium digest: a cell that drew anything else
# writes a differently named file and is reported no-artifact rather than silently
# paired against a block it does not share. The digests were reproduced on the
# workstation from the same corpus before this manifest was written.
# float32, not the stage default, and not a preference. The medium blocks these two
# rungs are placed beside were produced at float32 because a bfloat16 instability was
# measured on that checkpoint, and they are reused rather than re-scored; a ladder
# scored at two precisions is partly a comparison of arithmetic. This is the
# EXP-R2-224 pre-data amendment's binding declaration for stage 01 into stage 41.
# ProteinGym and MegaScale are scored at bfloat16 by that same amendment and are not
# this manifest's cells.
# Slots are homogeneous in rung so a slot barrier waits on like-sized cells: three
# slots of large, then three of xlarge, across the three cards this allocation
# exposes. float32 weights are about 11.1 GB for large and 25.8 GB for xlarge, both
# comfortable on one 143 GB card, so no cell shards.
